items.title: NCB Grants a Wish to Banana Ground
items.description:
Our ambassador, Elaine Thompson-Herah, recently launched her Fast Elaine Foundation, and we were happy to partner with her on our quest to grant wishes. 

Born and raised in Banana Ground, Manchester, the community has always held a special place in her heart, leading her to choose it as her grant recipient. 

The Fast Elaine Foundation was therefore awarded J$250,000 for its inaugural Christmas Care Initiative at which more than 500 residents from Banana Ground and surrounding areas were presented with Christmas care packages.

#EmpoweringPeople
#UnlockingDreams
#BuildingCommunities

text: I’m an Assistant Producer at CREATE, CNN’s global brand studio, working across international campaigns with productions in UAE, Saudi Arabia, Nigeria, and Gabon - to name just a few. My work starts in development, where I research and write production briefs and scripts. On location, I produce shoots, coordinate with crews, and oversee budgets. I then collaborate closely with editors throughout post-production to ensure each project is delivered on schedule and at the highest quality.

I am responsible for developing a slate of documentary projects spanning the UK and the Caribbean, across both feature films and series. My work includes crafting creative briefs, pitch decks, and treatments, as well as preparing funding applications and grant submissions to bring projects into production.

An independent feature film, a Jamaican love story exploring injustice and resilience, directed by Mykal Cushnie and written by Donisha Prendergast. It centres on the love between Malcolm, a factory worker, and Danielle, a seamstress, in Kingston, Jamaica. We shot across 9 days in May 2025. Our DP was Wentworth Kelly.
Rotterdam LAB - International Film Festival Rotterdam (IFFR)

I was thrilled to be selected for Rotterdam Lab, a renowned workshop for emerging producers to refine their craft and build an international network through panels, round-tables, and networking events!
